lens: mobile task completion, visual hierarchy, accessibility, and recovery
strengths: The r7 packet is frozen and consistent. I recomputed every SHA-256 listed in artifact-r7.md on September 4, 2026 and every listed product, localization, test, and documentation file matched, so the screenshots, source, product commit c431452, and /tmp/talent-signal-action-button-c431452.xcresult describe one stable release candidate.

The core setup remains the lightest honest version of Action Button capture I have seen in this release line. Screenshot 3CCAE38B-A080-47A9-8E02-AA93CEF28919.png shows one dominant task, the exact two-action Shortcut recipe, the local-before-you-decide boundary above the primary control, and an Open Shortcut editor CTA whose label and empty-editor disclosure match AppSettingsView.swift lines 399-440 rather than pretending the app can install a one-press shortcut by itself.

The setup entry stays highly discoverable without hype. Screenshot 9BE3703B-4A2E-41A1-96E3-A75CA7BFD4F0.png places Set up quick capture near the top of Workspace with the neutral One-time setup badge, matching RelationshipArchiveSheets.swift lines 680-696 and 809-841 and preserving calm hierarchy over novelty or sales language.

The status model remains visually honest. Screenshot 5638E563-863E-488F-BC6E-5FAA0459495C.png shows the unchecked I've assigned the Shortcut control still visible above Screenshot received via Shortcuts, while RelationshipArchiveSheets.swift lines 683-694, AgentSourceSettingsView.swift lines 269-283, and AppSettingsView.swift lines 486-499 and 600-614 keep Local receipt distinct from Assigned and describe the receipt as only a local review-queue handoff. The r7 xcresult shows testActionButtonSetupSeparatesObservedShortcutReceiptFromAssignment() and testActionButtonAssignmentAndReceiptStatesRemainIndependent() both passed.

The Chinese AX5 path remains readable and touch-safe across the reviewed hierarchy. Screenshot 23F307C1-00B3-494A-9A40-98FB2F106BAC.png preserves headline, recipe, local-boundary copy, and the primary CTA without clipping or overlap, and CandidateSignalUITests.swift lines 112-130 explicitly assert that the 打开快捷指令编辑器 control is visible, hittable, and at least 44 points high at AX5.

The broader Chinese Agent path now reads more complete without corrupting the capture truth model. Screenshots D5A64D76-0D8D-434A-A558-32A81DE90971.png and A10384E2-31A3-4CB8-9B1C-348D854AB108.png show that the Agent surface can lead into 来源与导入 and then 操作按钮与快捷指令 while keeping device capabilities, file import, and account-connection states distinct. AgentSourceSettingsView.swift lines 267-303 support that separation, and the Action Button row still says 去设置 or Local receipt instead of implying connected hardware state.

Recovery remains calm and explicit before any processing step. Screenshot 5B7E88EB-5F57-4D6A-9567-D4DC36EC8184.png presents Close this review?, Keep for later, and Discard capture before processing, while RelationshipCaptureView.swift lines 264-285 state that keeping preserves the screenshot and reviewed draft for the next app launch. The r7 xcresult shows testPendingScreenshotReviewOffersKeepOrDiscardBeforeProcessing() passed.

The release candidate now carries a documented bare-Debug fallback instead of leaving that launch state ambiguous. Screenshot E6F4EF2F-9485-43C4-BA2E-02AC4E6B9460.png shows a synthetic preview workspace rather than a broken blank or contradictory auth state, and CandidateSignalUITests.swift lines 19-26 explicitly assert editorial-today plus workspace-preview-boundary while authentication-screen remains absent.

The rejection boundary remains proven at the behavior level, not just described in copy. The r7 xcresult shows RelationshipCaptureTests/testShortcutImporterRejectsBeforeQueueAndReceipt() passed, and RelationshipCaptureTests.swift lines 48-123 verify that corrupt, over-25-MiB, and over-80-megapixel inputs create neither a queued capture nor a receipt timestamp.
missing_evidence: This is still evidence level 3 under the mobile-ux-reviewer rubric: I reviewed hash-matched source, screenshots, manifest evidence, and the final xcresult bundle, but I did not directly interact with the live release candidate during this r7 sign-off.

No connected physical iPhone was available on September 4, 2026, so this packet cannot prove real Action Button assignment, hardware press ergonomics, or device-specific failure behavior. I am treating Simulator evidence only as simulator evidence.

The AX5 screenshots and UI assertions are strong for layout and hit targets, but they still do not replace a direct VoiceOver pass for focus order, spoken labels, rotor behavior, and interruption handling on device.
